moments.text: Grey infrared view with a dark crosshair and black redaction boxes over the screen text; no object is visible yet.
After a grey flash, corner brackets close in around the crosshair; a tiny white dot lower right drifts left to just below the crosshair.
The view changes: two bright arcs frame the left and right sides, and a larger light blob slides right along the bottom edge.
The small light blob re-enters at lower right and wanders around the crosshair for over two minutes, never held at centre.
A square gate box appears around the crosshair, with a redaction box beside it; the blob sits just left of it.
The display tints the centre of the picture cyan; the object shows as a small cyan blob drifting left, below and right of centre.
The cyan tint goes off and the arc view returns; the blob keeps wandering near the crosshair, mostly above left.
Cyan tint returns for about 6 s with the cyan blob at left.
Arcs vanish; at 5:00 the view zooms in and the blob, now larger and white, drifts left, leaves the top, returns, then exits left.
After white flashes the arc view returns briefly, then a bright centre with dark corners; a small blob sits above left of the crosshair.
View zooms in on flat light grey: a white two-lobed blob drifts from the left onto the crosshair at 6:17, then back left.
The blob fades to faint grey left of the crosshair, turns white again at 6:30, then fades; one light flash at 6:32.
